title: add-rag-agent-templates-and-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Singh
release_notes: Adds RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and updates docs site with new examples and step-by-step guides for integrating Redwood agents with external tools.
body: Summary: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, three tool-calling quickstarts (HTTP fetcher, DB query, and calendar integration), and accompanying docs-site updates including example notebooks, API snippets, and end-to-end walkthroughs. Motivation: make it faster for developers to onboard RAG+agent use-cases with Redwood by providing vetted templates, canonical prompts, and operational guidance (caching, batching, and security notes). What changed: - new templates under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates (3 templates: faq-bot, support-assistant, internal-search) - quickstarts under redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/agents/tool-calling (http-fetcher, db-query, calendar) - example notebooks and minimal SDK samples for Python and TypeScript - docs site navigation and a new 'Agents & Tool Calling' landing page - added tests and CI snippets to validate example runs Checklist: - [x] Add templates and quickstarts - [x] Include end-to-end examples for SDKs (py/ts) - [x] Docs site landing + TOC updates - [x] Basic CI smoke tests for examples - [x] Security guidance for tool integrations (KMS, signed webhooks) Usage notes and security: templates default to using sandboxed tool adapters; quickstarts include guidance on secrets management, request validation, and rate limiting. Recommended rollout: merge to main, monitor examples smoke CI for 24 hours, announce in #dev-examples. How to review: Focus areas are templates/README for clarity, docs wording for operational guidance, and the quickstart scripts (ensure they run in CI). Links: docs preview at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/docs/agents-tool-calling (internal preview), Linear: ENG-4987, PM-1287.

summary: Provides a set of RAG agent templates, three tool-calling quickstarts, SDK examples, and docs site updates to accelerate developer onboarding for agent + tool integrations.
